name: proof-gate
description: The agent proposes. Python decides. Puts any agent's 'I fixed N bugs' claim on trial: re-runs the original tests against the new code, proves every new test fails before the fix, flags tampering, and scores against a hidden suite.
author: sarvar_04
highlights: Never asks the model whether it was right: deterministic Python is the judge
Re-runs the ORIGINAL tests against the new code, so editing a test cannot help
A new test only counts if it fails on the old code (RED) and passes on the new (GREEN)
Scores claimed fixes against a hidden suite the agent never saw
